title: Extending Occam's inversion with lasso fusion, overcomplete dictionaries, and isotropic total variation regularisation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14225v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Occam's inversion is a robust algorithm to perform nonlinear geophysical inversion. It provides the smoothest model within observation noise, thereby discouraging geological overinterpretation. While Occam originally penalised l2 model roughness, l1 can be used to provide models that are visually sharp. However, l1 regularised geophysical inversion has diverged from the larger body of statistics and imaging literature. For example, l1 regularisation with a difference operator (i.e., total variation) in multiple dimensions has two distinct forms, only one of which is invariant to edge orientation -- a distinction often overlooked in geophysics. In one dimension this reduces to the fused lasso problem in statistics. Within the Occam framework, for l2 data norm and l1 model regularisation, we show that lasso fusion through either synthesis or analysis leads to the same 1D problem. translated_title: 扩展奥卡姆反演：融合套索、过完备字典与各向同性全变差正则化
translated_abstract: 奥卡姆反演是一种稳健的非线性地球物理反演算法，它能在观测噪声范围内提供最平滑的模型，从而避免地质上的过度解释。虽然奥卡姆最初惩罚的是l2模型粗糙度，但l1可用于提供视觉上锐利的模型。然而，l1正则化地球物理反演已与更广泛的统计和成像文献脱节。例如，在多维空间中，使用差分算子（即全变差）的l1正则化有两种不同形式，其中只有一种对边缘方向具有不变性——这一区别在地球物理学中常被忽视。在一维情况下，这简化为统计学中的融合套索问题。在奥卡姆框架内，对于l2数据范数和l1模型正则化，我们表明通过综合或分析方式的套索融合会导致相同的一维问题。我们将该框架扩展到多维空间及算子中。
tldr: 本文扩展了奥卡姆反演框架，统一了l1正则化在不同维度下的形式，并展示了融合套索在综合与分析方式下的等价性，从而促进地球物理反演与现代统计方法接轨。
en_tdlr: This paper extends Occam's inversion framework, unifies l1 regularization forms across dimensions, and demonstrates the equivalence of fused lasso in synthesis and analysis, bridging geophysical inversion with modern statistical methods.
